1.title: 60 Posts in 10 Hours: How Trump’s Social Media Reflects His Version of Reality
1.summary: With an assist from A.I., President Trump offers a window into how he wants to be seen — and, critics say, a barometer of his mental state.

2.title: William Anderson, Doctor and Civil Rights Leader in Georgia, Dies at 98
2.summary: An osteopath in Albany, Ga., he drew national attention, and the involvement of the Rev. Dr. Martin Luther King Jr., for his efforts to end segregation.

3.title: Apple unveils its first folding iPhone
3.summary: Apple showed off at an event the first major design change to the iPhone in almost 20 years.

4.title: Spain Declassifies Warning to Morocco About Migrant Crossing Plans
4.summary: Spain’s intelligence service had alerted Morocco about social media calls for a border exodus into Ceuta, which led to more than 100 deaths and a political crisis in Spain.

5.title: Two die at Moldovan border as Russia-Ukraine drone war rages
5.summary: Five deaths are reported in Ukraine and four in Russia as both sides launch new drone strikes.

6.title: 14 Killed in Weapons Depot Blast in Northwest Syria
6.summary: Officials said they had not determined the cause of the explosion. Years of fighting have left Syria littered with weapons and ordnance left over from the civil war.
